maya: T-minus 9m before RC cutoff. PR #9123 has the hotfix + rollback guard. Need 2 LGTM before T-0 or autobackout kicks in. Can folks scan quickly? :alarm_clock:
zack: On it, doing a 2min skim now.
li: I can run smoke and a quick perf check in ~4m, ping me the steps.
maya: smoke steps: `./scripts/smoke.sh --env staging && curl -fsS https://staging.redwood.internal/health` — expect 200 and p95 <120ms. Also watch for the kv-cache warmup logs.
deploy-bot: Heads-up: deploy window opens in 9 minutes. Autobackout policy = abort + rollback if approvals <2 at cutoff. Details: https://redwood/internal/deploy-policy (internal).
sophia: Skimming changes now. Looks low-risk; one minor log formatting nit but not blocking. Will approve after CI green.
omar: CI has one flaky e2e on the matrix, re-running now.
li: Smoke running: `smoke.sh` returned 200, p95 ~98ms on first pass. kv-cache warmup logs show expected hits.
zack: Left a small comment on error path in PR — not a blocker but would be nice to follow up.
sophia: Approving now. :white_check_mark:
li: Approving — smoke + perf pass. :white_check_mark:
maya: Great, that's 2 approvals. Locking for merge at cutoff. Canary rollout policy will be default (5 hosts, ramp 20%).
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1765555580 on 5 hosts. Monitoring CPU/latency/error-rate for 10m.
maya: Merge executed at cutoff, deploying RC. Thanks all — please watch alerts for next 15m. :tada:
